title: unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflow-improvements
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: We need more robust observability and safety guards for unified rollouts (canary, A/B, shadow) to reduce incident risk caused by regressions in model variants. This PR extends the autorollback workflow to include metric quorum checks, enhanced telemetry for weighted canaries, and a probe staging phase that quarantines suspicious traffic before full rollback. Motivation: recent incidents (linked SUP-987) highlighted gaps where noisy metrics caused premature or missed rollbacks. Goals: 1) Reduce false-positive rollbacks by requiring quorum across multiple telemetry sources; 2) Improve visibility into rollout decisions with per-probing-stage traces and traces tied to request ids; 3) Add a manual quarantine step and an automated probing stage that can promote or demote traffic based on composite metrics. Changes included: runtime: add autorollback engine hook to rollout controller; rollout engine: implement quorum evaluator and composite metric scorer; telemetry: emit rollout_decision and probe_result spans, add rollout.trace_id to request logs; API: extend rollout spec with probingStage and quarantineWindow; e2e: add scenarios for weighted canary + shadow traffic with flaky metric sources; tests: unit tests for quorum thresholds and end-to-end integration tests in perf-canary harness. Checklist: [x] design doc updated and linked in Linear ENG-2345; [x] unit and integration tests added; [x] e2e stability test in perf-canary passing locally; [x] docs updated in redwood-docs for rollout spec; [ ] staged deployment scheduled. Risk and mitigation: new quorum logic is behind feature flag rollout.quorum-v2 and default behavior preserved; probes run at reduced traffic rate and quarantineWindow defaults to 5m; we added canary-threshold guards to prevent oscillation. Rollout plan: deploy behind feature flag to canary clusters, run synthetic probing for 48h, gradually widen to 10% of customers, monitor rollback alerts and manual quarantine triggers. Related: ENG-2410, PRs in redwood-helm-charts and perf-canary for test harness integration.

feat(autorollback): implement quorum evaluator and composite metric scorer

test(e2e): add weighted canary + shadow scenarios in perf-canary
docs: update rollout spec reference and examples in redwood-docs
review_comments: Marco Li: Can you add a unit test that covers a 3-source quorum where one source is delayed? We should ensure delayed telemetry doesn't prevent rollback when quorum is already reached.
Aisha Patel: Added tests covering delayed sources and updated quorum evaluator to consider timeouts. See tests/unit/autorollback/quorum_evaluator_test.go commit.
Jordan Kim: Telemetry naming looks good, but please ensure trace sampling rate doesn't blow up in high-throughput clusters.
Aisha Patel: Sampling rate set to 0.1 for rollout traces by default and configurable via telemetry.rollout_sample_rate.
Sofia Martinez: Suggest adding an e2e case for shadow traffic that uses synthetic anomalies; otherwise approved pending CI.
Aisha Patel: Added perf-canary scenario and extended e2e harness; CI flake observed on first run and rerun passed.
review_summary: Approved by reviewers after adding delayed-source unit tests and limiting rollout trace sampling. CI initially flaky on e2e but green after rerun.
release_notes: Enhancements to unified rollouts: added probingStage and quarantineWindow to rollout spec; introduced quorum-based autorollback to reduce false positives; improved telemetry for rollout decisions; added e2e tests for weighted canary + shadow scenarios.
backout_procedure: Revert feature flag rollout.quorum-v2 and deploy previous controller image tag; run manual quarantine to isolate probes; notify oncall and roll out safe model variant. Detailed steps in ENG-2345.
testing_summary: Unit tests for quorum evaluator and composite metric scorer; integration tests in staging with synthetic anomalies; perf-canary e2e scenario passed on rerun. Observability dashboards added to monitor rollout_decision counts and probe_result distributions.
notes: Feature gated and deployed to two canary clusters for 48h. No user-visible rollback occurred during canary. Planning gradual expansion next week.
